definition: Fernando Pereira is VP at Google DeepMind and pioneer of statistical NLP.
details: Co-introduced Conditional Random Fields (CRFs) and led natural language processing and machine learning research at Google. Fernando Pereira (10 May 1950 – 10 July 1985) was a Portuguese-Dutch freelance photographer, who drowned when French intelligence (DGSE) detonated a bomb and sank the Rainbow Warrior, owned by the environmental organisation Greenpeace on 10 July 1985. The bombing of the boat had been designed to make the ship unsalvageable. The first smaller bomb bent the propeller shaft, making repair uneconomic.

explainer.lead: Fernando Pereira was a Portuguese-Dutch photographer (1950–1985).

contributions.name: The second, more powerful explosion, designed to sink the boat, caused a huge inrush of seawater that drowned Pereira.
